paragraphs: AI Software Engineer focused on turning large language models into dependable product features: agents that call tools, retrieval-augmented generation over real data, and AI-assisted workflows that users can trust.

I come to AI engineering from 6+ years of full-stack work across React, Angular, Node.js, Java/Spring Boot and AWS, including a single codebase serving 9 brands on web, Android and iOS. That background is the part of AI engineering most demos skip: secure APIs, authentication, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes and the reliability work that gets an LLM feature into production.

I hold an M.S. in Management Information Systems (GPA 4.0) from the University at Buffalo with coursework in Applied AI and Predictive Analytics, and I build with OpenAI and Claude APIs, LangChain, LangGraph and Llama models.
